3 to consummate a marriage, to have intercourse

(2:237) وَإِنْ‏ ‏طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏قَبْلِ‏ ‏أَنْ‏ ‏تَمَسُّوهُنَّ‏ ‏ but if you divorce them before consummating the marriage

4 to comprehend, to appreciate (in an interpretation of verse 56:79) لاَ‏ ‏يَمَسُّهُ‏ ‏إِلاَّ‏ ‏الْمُطَهَّرُونَ none but the purified can comprehend it.

entries.label: م-س-س
entries.definitionHtml:
م/س/س   m–s–s to touch, to feel
; to cohabit; to hit, to befall, to harm, to afflict, slight madness, slight fever; to be mean, to be extreme; thirst‐quenching water, verdant pasture; antidote.

Of this root. 4 forms occur 60 times in the Qur’an:

مَسَّ massa 55 times;
يَتَمَاسَّا yatamāssā 2 times; مَسّ mass 2 times and مِسَاس misās 1 time
.

entries.label: مَسَّ
entries.definitionHtml:
مَسَّ massa a [v. trans.]

1 to touch

(56:79) لاَ‏ ‏يَمَسُّهُ‏ ‏إِلاَّ‏ ‏الْمُطَهَّرُونَ none but the purified can touch it

2 to afflict, to befall

3 to consummate a marriage, to have intercourse

entries.label: مَسّ
entries.definitionHtml:
مَسّ mass [n./v. n.] touching, affliction

(2:275)‏الَّذِي‏ ‏يَتَخَبَّطُهُ‏ ‏الشَّيْطَانُ‏ ‏مِنَ‏ ‏الْمَسِّ‏ the one whom Satan confounds by [his] touch.

entries.label: مِسَاس
entries.definitionHtml:
مِسَاس misās [v. n.] touch, touching *

(20:97)‏لاَ‏ ‏مِسَاسَ‏ ‏ [interjection] there shall be no touching!, I shall not touch nor will I be touched (an expression originally used in Arabia at times of epidemics).

entries.label: يَتَمَاسَّ
entries.definitionHtml:
يَتَمَاسَّ yatamāss [imperf of v. VI, تَمَاسَّ tamāssa, intrans.] to have intercourse with another person

(58:3) ‏فَتَحْرِيرُ‏ ‏رَقَبَةٍ‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏قَبْلِ‏ ‏أَنْ‏ ‏يَتَمَاسَّا‏ the freeing of a slave before the two of them touch one another.
